desc:
🌟 Explore a social plaza filled with diverse themed booths to discover, customize, roleplay, and engage with other players.

🏪 Claim a booth, personalize it with props and colors, host scenes, or simply explore what others have created.

• 🗺️ 90+ unique themed booths to explore
• 🎨 Customize and decorate your booth with props and materials
• 🎭 Spaces for art, shows, and creative expression
• 🏛️ Roleplay environments like court, hospital, and school
• 🔊 Use gear items like boomboxes, cameras, or text signs
• 🔎 Discover hidden nametags
• 🌦️ Dynamic weather and time

✨ 95 booths • 50 gears • 50 nametags • 77 props

🛡️ Seen something? Open a ticket in our communication server (link under social links)
(Banned from the server? Appeal server found in the group under Communication Appeals)
